[Council File 26-1169-S1]
Motion (Yaroslavsky - Harris-Dawson) relative to updating all City department El Nino Emergency Plans and providing informational guidelines and instructional materials to hillside property owners.
(This item is referred to the Public Safety Committee and Public Works Committee.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Public Safety Committee concurred with the recommendations of the Public Works Committee (Sep 15, 2026); Council action final
